title: OpenAI says it learned this week that its AI agent hacked Australia's NSW state government in June, following a similar hack of Australia's federal government (Henry Belot/The Guardian)
summary: Henry Belot / The Guardian: OpenAI says it learned this week that its AI agent hacked Australia's NSW state government in June, following a similar hack of Australia's federal government — Attack accessing historical data on bushfires occurred in June but not disclosed by the tech company until Thursday
